display_name: Licence grades, eligibility, validity and fees for refrigeration and air-conditioning work in Israel -- with the two enacted texts of the fee regulation on L4's rule-effective-time axis, and the SimpLEX draft beside it as a counterfactual

language.note: Body text and identifiers are English (@lang en); every rule carries an English @nlg herald and a Hebrew @nlg:he herald, so `l4 nlg --lang he` and `l4 render --lang he` produce a Hebrew document from the same module. A Hebrew-canonical twin row, encodings/legalese-he/, is GENERATED from this row by source/revoice.py and encodings/legalese-he/glossary.json (Hebrew identifiers, headings and default heralds; English under --lang en); this row is the one edited by hand. See NOTES.md section 6.

generated_modules.hvac-tests-generated.l4: GENERATED by source/gen-tests.py, an independent Python re-implementation of the same rules; do not edit by hand, regenerate.

expected_red.hvac-tests-simplex-red.l4: MEANT TO FAIL with exactly 3 failed assertions: the SimpLEX draft's own test expectations run against the Regulations as made. check.sh counts them. It is also the positive control proving the harness can fail.

scope: Law: s.2 licence grades (18 kW / 70 kW thresholds), s.3(a)-(b) duty to hold a licence, s.6(a) conditions for grant with the whole Second Schedule (three parts, every row, including the three-year sunset on the experience-only routes), s.7 training exemptions, s.8 validity and renewal, s.9 temporary licence for a foreign expert with its two renewals, s.16 duty to report a change of details (as a regulative rule), s.17(a) and (c) continuing education, s.63(a)-(b) commencement. Fees Regulations: reg. 1-5 in full. The TWO ENACTED texts of reg. 2 -- as made (Kovetz HaTakanot 11951, 5785 p. 2116, in force 16 July 2025) and as amended (Kovetz HaTakanot 12383, 5786 p. 2062, in force 4 May 2026) -- are ONE rule on L4's rule-effective-time axis, selected by RULES EFFECTIVE DATE and pinned by callers with EVAL UNDER RULES EFFECTIVE AT; before 16 July 2025 it answers NOTHING, because the Regulations did not yet exist. The never-enacted SimpLEX draft (Fig. 4 of Schwartz, Bar-Siman-Tov & Gelbard 2025) is encoded beside the axis as an explicitly-labelled counterfactual, reached by name and never by date, because a draft has no commencement and is therefore not a point on any timeline. regs 3, 4 and 5 are encoded once and shared. See NOTES.md section 3.1. NOT encoded: ss.4, 10-15, 18 (operators), Chapter D (registrar and council), Chapter E (inspection), Chapter F (administrative enforcement, and the Third Schedule of sanction amounts), the First Schedule (the list of works per grade) and the Fourth Schedule (flammable refrigerants). Law stated as at 2026-05-04 (the Wikisource revision deposited).

not_reviewed.note: No human who knows Israeli vocational-licensing law has read this against the statute. An adversarial model review against the Hebrew text was run before deposit and its findings are recorded in NOTES.md section 5.

forks.F1: s.8 'the fifth year from the year in which the licence was granted' read as grant year + 5; the alternative reading grant year + 4 is recorded in NOTES.md section 4.
forks.F2: reg. 3 rounding 'to the nearest whole new shekel' at exactly one half: half-up adopted.
forks.F3: The draft vintage of reg. 2 is transcribed from a screenshot in a published paper, not from a deposited draft; its 2(e) cites 's.8 of the Law' where the bill and the Act say s.9. The transcription is recorded in the module's comments.
forks.F4: Second Schedule Part B: the Ministry of Education five-unit certificate appears in item 1 column B and again in item 5 column A, and the two rows conflict. The encoding follows item 5 (50 hours owed). NOTES.md section 4.
forks.F5: The licence fee's charging event -- the draft charges the APPLICATION, the text as made charges the RECEIPT -- and the appeal aggregate: the draft's 2(c) adds the 40 to 'the fee under (a)', the theoretical fee, whichever examination is appealed, so a practical-examination appellant tenders 313 on the literal reading. NOTES.md section 4.
forks.F6: The commencement of the 5786 amendment. Kovetz HaTakanot 12383 of 4 May 2026 contains NO commencement provision at all. Adopted: 4 May 2026, the day of publication, under s.17 of the Interpretation Ordinance [New Version]. Rejected: 11 May 2026, on the argument that the amendment rides the principal Regulations' own reg. 5. This is a boundary on the rule-effective-time axis, so the answers turn on it. NOTES.md section 4.
